§6Circuit Components§f

§aVacuum tubes, capacitors, PCBs, microchips. The atoms of your electronics.§f

All higher circuits are built from these base components. Automate them early or you'll drown in manual crafting.

§bVacuum Tube§f: Glass + tungsten wire + insulator. Also found in IBM PCs and satellite dishes.
§bCapacitor§f: Insulator + copper wire + aluminium powder. You'll need hundreds.
§bPCB§f: Insulator + copper plate.
§bMicrochip§f: Printed silicon wafer + copper wire + insulator.
§bVersatile IC§f: PCB + microchips + bismuth.

Upgrades: §bTantalium Capacitor§f (better insulator + tantalium nugget), §bAtomic Clock§f (microchips + strontium), §bQuantum Processor§f (hard plastic + BSCCO wire + ionized particles).

§ePS:§f Capacitors and PCBs are the bottleneck. Set up automation before you scale.
